rounds.summary: Full independent review against the actual code at dev @ dff46746 (clean tree; read-only checks only, including two targeted starlette 0.48.0 probes via the venv python with cache/bytecode writes disabled). Verdict CHANGES_REQUIRED, five findings. F-1 HIGH: the CSRF root-cause narrative ('request.cookies keeps only the FIRST duplicate') and the single-header live-repro claim contradicted verified starlette behavior — Request.cookies parses only the FIRST raw Cookie header (headers.get('cookie')) and within one header the LAST duplicate wins; probes: two header entries → first (stale) kept (the real 403 shape, matching the live curl repro which sent two Cookie headers); single header 'stale; fresh' → fresh kept (passes today); single header 'fresh; stale' → stale kept (also a 403 shape). AC-BE-CSRF case 2 as written was satisfiable by a vacuous test passing on UNPATCHED code. F-2 MEDIUM: claimed the stash carried only deps.py (later withdrawn — reviewer method error: plain `git stash show` hides untracked files; `git stash show --include-untracked` returns BOTH deps.py and the test file, confirmed at the object level via the stash's untracked-files parent commit). F-3 MEDIUM: form.hbs forwards only four keys into the Button helper — without disabled=this.disabled forwarding the planned disabled attribute never renders (AC-FE-LOADING would fail). F-4 MINOR: WS-FE-AUTH-UX dependsOn [] contradicted its launchGate ('WS-BE-CSRF accepted'). F-5 MINOR: 'backend verify green' is unachievable as exit-0 on this stand (verify.sh set -euo pipefail + 4 pre-existing converter failures reproduced live) — verdict must be a delta contract. NOTES: N1 Enter-claim overstated (dispatched submit events reach Form's handler regardless of the button; implicit-submission behavior around disabled default buttons is historically inconsistent — guard still correct and necessary); N2 input.hbs value rendering open (either safe; conditional keeps profile markup unchanged); N3 tier-request requirementsBytes metadata slightly off (not load-bearing); N4 plan acceptance-check CLI errors repo-wide including on the previously accepted 2026-11-06 package (format mismatch, not a plan defect; completeness-check validates the embedded acceptance); N5 SEC-CSRF-ANY-COPY-BOUNDS 'issued by the site' aspirational but not a weakening; N6 readOnly vs forbidden-write wording. Coverage verified: CSRF fix mechanism itself correct for every duplicate arrangement (getlist exists; naive split adequate for token_urlsafe values; validate_origin-first preserved; existing CSRF tests single-value/missing-header shaped — unaffected); loader feasibility verified end to end (ComponentProps MUST gain the field — excess-property check via withStore contextual return type; pages already override render(); Button tests use a local MockButton); value-preservation lifecycle verified (registerComponent constructs new instances per compile; CDU runs before render/replaceWith so the old DOM is readable via this.element; input.ts/labeledInput.ts/login.hbs/register.hbs correctly need NO changes); write-sets disjoint and exact; forbiddenWrites genuinely unneeded by the plan; gates runnable on this stand; REQ/AC/EV ids consistent; tier digest b570c84a… independently recomputed; budget arithmetic sane; package dir contains exactly the 8 declared planFiles.
